hero_lead: Collision repair serving Crestline, CA. Start with a mobile photo estimate, get insurance guidance, and plan repair at Showtime Collision in Running Springs.
review_quote: The customer service was awesome. Just picked up my car and it’s absolutely perfect. Showtime knows how to make a happy customer.
faq1_question: Can Crestline customers submit an online estimate?
faq1_answer: Yes. Open the Carwise link on a mobile phone and follow the guided photo prompts.
faq2_question: How far along is the price from photos?
faq2_answer: Photo review is preliminary. Hidden damage, scans, measurements, and disassembly may be required for a complete repair plan.
faq3_question: Can I choose Showtime even if my insurer recommends another shop?
faq3_answer: Customers generally have the right to choose their repair facility. Ask Showtime to review the estimate and explain the process.
faq4_question: What should I do if warning lights are on after the accident?
faq4_answer: Call before driving. Warning lights can indicate safety, restraint, suspension, cooling, or electronic-system concerns.
